## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (ud-q2_k_xl, needs ~54.5 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:UD-Q2_K_XL
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:UD-Q2_K_XL
   ```

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (ud-q2_k_xl, needs ~54.5 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF@UD-Q2_K_XL -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Q4_K_M, needs ~108.5 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/qwen3.8-flash-next/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run qwen3.8-flash-next:125b-a6b-q4_K_M
   ```

### Strata

1. Install Strata. Runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next split across your graphics card, RAM and SSD: an NVIDIA or AMD card with 12 GB or more, Windows or Linux.
   
   ```sh
   # Windows / Linux
   git clone https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata.git && cd Strata
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (UD-IQ4_XS, needs 12 GB VRAM + 80 GB RAM, 93.7 GB download, NVIDIA or AMD card only, from [github.com/Niko1221](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/blob/a0116b2782a5b82622358c04a06496485d12b2d6/setup.py#L228))
   
   ```sh
   ./setup.sh --yes --family unsloth --model UD-IQ4_XS --no-start && ./run-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs.sh
   ```

3. Windows (cmd): set up this size
   
   ```sh
   START-HERE.bat --yes --family unsloth --model UD-IQ4_XS --no-start
   ```

4. Then start it
   
   ```sh
   run-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs.bat
   ```

5. And open http://127.0.0.1:8080 (an OpenAI-compatible API at /v1)

Other versions: IQ3_S (12 GB VRAM + 62 GB RAM, 83.6 GB download, NVIDIA or AMD card only) `./setup.sh --yes --family qwen --model IQ3_S --no-start && ./run-iq3_s.sh` · IQ3_XXS (12 GB VRAM + 60 GB RAM, 75.8 GB download, NVIDIA or AMD card only) `./setup.sh --yes --family qwen --model IQ3_XXS --no-start && ./run-iq3_xxs.sh` · IQ2_XS (12 GB VRAM + 48 GB RAM, 68 GB download, NVIDIA or AMD card only) `./setup.sh --yes --family qwen --model IQ2_XS --no-start && ./run-iq2_xs.sh` · Q2_0 (12 GB VRAM + 48 GB RAM, 66.4 GB download, NVIDIA or AMD card only) `./setup.sh --yes --family qwen --model Q2_0 --no-start && ./run-q2_0.sh`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/Qwen](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next)
